messages.subject: Apply for intensive collaboration with Datalab
parts:
The UC Davis Datalab is currently accepting applications for our annual program of “startup projects”, which provide UC Davis researchers with twelve weeks (during Spring Quarter) of intensive collaboration on data-driven research free of cost. See the call for applications at Datalab’s website: https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/news/apply-for-datalabs-annual-start-up-award-to-accelerate-your-research/. We generally use some of these projects as mentoring opportunities for small teams of undergraduate students.

The application deadline is next week (2/18) though I’ve heard that there may be some flexibility there if you contact the Datalab in advance of the deadline. Please pass the word along to anyone you think would be interested. Thanks!

—
Wes
